name: The Good News According to Luke

verses.text: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
He said, “Truly \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w this \+w poor \+w widow \+w put \+w in \+w more \+w than \+w all \+w of \+w them *

\+w for \+w all \+w these \+w put \+w in \+w gifts \+w for \+w God \+w from \+w their \+w abundance \+w but \+w she \+w out \+w of \+w her \+w poverty \+w put \+w in \+w all \+w that \+w she \+w had \+w to \+w live \+w on
As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

“\+w As \+w for \+w these \+w things \+w which \+w you \+w see \+w the \+w days \+w will \+w come \+w in \+w which \+w there \+w will \+w not \+w be left \+w here \+w one \+w stone \+w on \+w another \+w that \+w will \+w not \+w be thrown \+w down
They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

He said, “Watch \+w out \+w that \+w you don’\+w t \+w get \+w led \+w astray \+w for \+w many \+w will \+w come \+w in \+w my \+w name \+w saying ‘\+w I \+w am \+w he \+w and ‘\+w The \+w time \+w is \+w at \+w hand \+w Therefore don’\+w t \+w follow \+w them *

\+w When \+w you hear \+w of \+w wars \+w and disturbances, don’\+w t \+w be \+w terrified \+w for \+w these \+w things \+w must \+w happen \+w first \+w but \+w the \+w end won’\+w t \+w come \+w immediately
Then he said to them, “\+w Nation \+w will \+w rise \+w against \+w nation \+w and kingdom \+w against kingdom. *

\+w There \+w will \+w be \+w great \+w earthquakes \+w famines \+w and \+w plagues \+w in \+w various \+w places \+w There \+w will \+w be \+w terrors \+w and \+w great \+w signs \+w from \+w heaven *

\+w But \+w before \+w all \+w these \+w things \+w they \+w will \+w lay \+w their \+w hands \+w on \+w you \+w and \+w will \+w persecute \+w you \+w delivering \+w you \+w up \+w to \+w synagogues \+w and \+w prisons bringing \+w you \+w before \+w kings \+w and \+w governors \+w for \+w my \+w name \+w sake *
\+w It \+w will turn \+w out \+w as \+w a \+w testimony \+w for \+w you *
\+w Settle \+w it \+w therefore \+w in \+w your \+w hearts \+w not \+w to meditate \+w beforehand \+w how \+w to answer, *
\+w for \+w I \+w will \+w give \+w you \+w a \+w mouth \+w and \+w wisdom \+w which \+w all \+w your adversaries \+w will \+w not \+w be \+w able \+w to withstand \+w or \+w to contradict. *

\+w You \+w will \+w be \+w handed \+w over \+w even \+w by \+w parents brothers, \+w relatives \+w and \+w friends \+w They \+w will \+w cause \+w some \+w of \+w you \+w to \+w be \+w put \+w to \+w death *
\+w You \+w will \+w be \+w hated \+w by \+w all \+w men \+w for \+w my \+w name \+w sake *
\+w And \+w not \+w a \+w hair \+w of \+w your \+w head \+w will perish.*
“\+w By \+w your \+w endurance \+w you \+w will win \+w your \+w lives
“\+w But \+w when \+w you \+w see \+w Jerusalem \+w surrounded \+w by \+w armies \+w then \+w know \+w that \+w its \+w desolation \+w is \+w at \+w hand *

\+w Then \+w let \+w those \+w who \+w are \+w in \+w Judea \+w flee \+w to \+w the \+w mountains \+w Let \+w those \+w who \+w are \+w in \+w the \+w middle \+w of \+w her depart. \+w Let \+w those \+w who \+w are \+w in \+w the \+w country \+w not \+w enter \+w therein *
\+w For \+w these \+w are \+w days \+w of \+w vengeance \+w that \+w all \+w things \+w which \+w are \+w written \+w may \+w be fulfilled. *

\+w Woe \+w to \+w those \+w who \+w are \+w pregnant \+w and \+w to \+w those \+w who nurse infants \+w in \+w those \+w days \+w For \+w there \+w will \+w be \+w great distress \+w in \+w the \+w land \+w and \+w wrath \+w to \+w this \+w people *

\+w They \+w will \+w fall \+w by \+w the \+w edge \+w of \+w the \+w sword \+w and \+w will \+w be led captive \+w into \+w all \+w the \+w nations \+w Jerusalem \+w will \+w be \+w trampled \+w down \+w by \+w the \+w Gentiles \+w until \+w the \+w times \+w of \+w the \+w Gentiles \+w are \+w fulfilled *

“\+w There \+w will \+w be \+w signs \+w in \+w the \+w sun \+w moon \+w and stars; \+w and \+w on \+w the \+w earth anxiety \+w of \+w nations \+w in perplexity \+w for \+w the \+w roaring \+w of \+w the \+w sea \+w and \+w the \+w waves *

\+w men fainting \+w for \+w fear \+w and \+w for \+w expectation \+w of \+w the \+w things \+w which \+w are \+w coming \+w on \+w the \+w world \+w for \+w the \+w powers \+w of \+w the \+w heavens \+w will \+w be \+w shaken *
\+w Then \+w they \+w will \+w see \+w the \+w Son \+w of \+w Man \+w coming \+w in \+w a \+w cloud \+w with \+w power \+w and \+w great \+w glory *
\+w But \+w when \+w these \+w things begin \+w to \+w happen \+w look \+w up \+w and \+w lift \+w up \+w your \+w heads \+w because \+w your redemption \+w is \+w near
He told them a parable. “\+w See \+w the \+w fig \+w tree \+w and \+w all \+w the \+w trees *
\+w When \+w they \+w are \+w already budding, \+w you \+w see \+w it \+w and \+w know \+w by \+w your \+w own \+w selves \+w that \+w the \+w summer \+w is \+w already \+w near *
\+w Even \+w so \+w you \+w also \+w when \+w you \+w see \+w these \+w things \+w happening \+w know \+w that \+w God Kingdom \+w is \+w near *
Most \+w certainly \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w this \+w generation \+w will \+w not \+w pass \+w away \+w until \+w all \+w things \+w are \+w accomplished *
\+w Heaven \+w and \+w earth \+w will \+w pass \+w away \+w but \+w my \+w words \+w will \+w by \+w no \+w means \+w pass \+w away

“\+w So \+w be \+w careful \+w or \+w your \+w hearts \+w will \+w be loaded down \+w with carousing, \+w drunkenness \+w and \+w cares \+w of \+w this life, \+w and \+w that \+w day \+w will \+w come \+w on \+w you suddenly. *
\+w For \+w it \+w will \+w come \+w like \+w a \+w snare \+w on \+w all \+w those \+w who \+w dwell \+w on \+w the surface \+w of \+w all \+w the \+w earth *

\+w Therefore \+w be watchful \+w all \+w the \+w time \+w praying \+w that \+w you \+w may \+w be counted worthy \+w to \+w escape \+w all \+w these \+w things \+w that \+w will \+w happen \+w and \+w to \+w stand \+w before \+w the \+w Son \+w of \+w Man
Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
